nl: 合同审核：表格上方左侧「新增合同」、右侧「批量导出」；表格展示合同编号、审核结果、审核人、审核时间；「审核结果」列需要自定义渲染（用不同颜色的标签展示通过/驳回）；支持新增、删除、导出；新增、删除按钮需要权限码 review:add、review:remove。
nlEn: Contract review: above the table "New Contract" is on the left and "Batch Export" on the right; the table shows contract no., review result, reviewer, and review time; the "review result" column needs custom rendering (colored tags for passed/rejected); supports add, delete, and export; the add and delete buttons require permission codes review:add, review:remove.
notes: 三维覆盖：tableBtns + permissions + extPoints(render 自定义单元格)。render 仅 schema 模式且承载字段 reviewResult 必须 inTable:true，否则不产 TODO(es-plus) stub + warning，check 9 会红。
